title: Baumslag-Solitar subgroups of the mapping class group
summary: For $g\geq 2$ and nonzero integers $p,q$, let $\mathrm{Mod}(S_g)$ be the mapping class group of a closed oriented surface $S_g$ of genus $g$, and let $\mathrm{BS}(p,q)$ be the Baumslag-Solitar group. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions under which two mapping classes $G,F\in \mathrm{Mod}(S_g)$ generate a subgroup isomorphic to $\mathrm{BS}(p,q)$. In particular, if $\mathrm{BS}(p,q)$ embeds in $\mathrm{Mod}(S_g)$, then $|p|=|q|$ and $G,F$ are reducible mapping classes of infinite order. We also construct subgroups isomorphic to $\mathrm{BS}(p,p)$ and $\mathrm{BS}(p,-p)$ for $p>1$.…
